audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..5].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0..5] already read 'Blitzcrank', and phases[6].side reads 'Skill' while win[6] reads 'Zilean' — the chart contradicts itself at every row.
audit.why: Zilean is immobile with no early lockdown per the kit (Time Bomb stun needs two bombs to combo), so content's whys[0..5] correctly favor Blitzcrank early; late, whys[6] correctly flips to Zilean once Chronoshift can revive a hooked target. The full layer's generic 'Skill' rows never caught up to either call.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side moved to 'Blitzcrank', phases[6].side moved to 'Zilean', all with why text grounded in the kit; win[] already matched these targets so it was left alone per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), even though Chronoshift's rank-1 vs rank-3 cooldown gap (120s down to 60s) is exactly the kind of number that should anchor this field.
audit.why: The R is the whole late-game swing point in this matchup per whys[6]/spikes[3] — stating its real cooldown lets a reader know how long a wasted Chronoshift stays down.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites the 120s-to-60s R cooldown.

edits.before: The hook threat IS level 1 — their duo plays behind minions or pays immediately.
edits.after: Zilean is immobile with no defensive layer at level 1 — walking up threatens Rocket Grab and forces him back.

edits.before: E joins: hook-fist is live and the lane's geometry answers to your arm.
edits.after: Level 2 is yours: a landed Grab converts before his double-bomb stun combo is reliable.

edits.before: Full kit: W the flank angles — the hook from fog is the lane's scariest sentence.
edits.after: Dodge his lobbed Time Bomb and hook on its cooldown — he has no other way to stop your Grab.

edits.before: Zone with the arm — every minion they hide behind is tempo you taxed for free.
edits.after: Hug the wave and punish every CS step he takes with a grab — Time Warp only slows, it doesn't stop the pull.

edits.before: Static Field online — the silence finishes what the fist started.
edits.after: Still ahead pre-item: Chronoshift saves his target from death but does nothing to stop your hook from landing.

edits.before: First item: the grab chains delete and the overdrive flanks multiply.
edits.after: First item stays yours — his lobbed stun is dodgeable before you commit, and he still has no answer to a landed Grab.

edits.before: Late Blitz is one hook from winning: fish the chokes, fist the catch, and silence the channel.
edits.after: Flips to Zilean: a stacked Chronoshift revives whoever you hook, so your pick threat stops guaranteeing a kill.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Zilean Chronoshift (R): 120s at rank 1, down to 60s at rank 3 — force it early or you're hooking through a free revive. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Zilean has no CC of his own until his passive stacks a second bomb — a clean early hook is close to free.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Standing in Time Bomb range between hooks lets him plant one that stuns if a second bomb detonates it early.
